Help manual

Library & tagging

Browse tracks, assign Tags and Energy, and arrange Playlists.

On this page
  • Import and browse
  • Tags and filters
  • Playlists
  • Archive

Import and browse

  1. Scan a tracks directory, or drop files onto the Library in the Desktop shell.
  2. Browse sidebar lists or search by text. Select a track; check title, artist, BPM, and Key. Keep its music drive connected.

Tags and filters

  1. Click Tags to assign or remove them. Use tag management to edit Tags, Categories, and tag colors; assignments save immediately.
  2. With Library keyboard focus, press T, search, then Enter to assign a Tag; Escape exits. Press E, then 1–5, for Energy, a separate attribute.
  3. Combine text, BPM, Key, Energy, and Tag filters. ANY matches any selected Tag; ALL requires every selected Tag. Clear filters if tracks disappear.

Playlists

  1. Choose + New… → Playlist; drag tracks onto it.
  2. Sort by # / Play order, clear filters, then drag rows to reorder. Other column sorts change only the view.

Archive

Right-click → Archive track retains audio and metadata but removes Playlist memberships. Archived → Unarchive does not restore those memberships.
